pages.title: Independent Points
pages.text: Each specialization has its own XP, level, and points. Fire Points pay for Fire nodes; Two-Handed Points pay for Two-Handed nodes.$(br2)Select a node to see its owning tree, cost, current rank, and prerequisites. Purchasing a rank spends points only from that tree.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Nodes can require earlier purchases, proficiency levels, world progression, or other conditions. Related specializations may unlock a synergy together.$(br2)The server checks purchases and casts. Read the explanation shown after a rejected action. Pack authors can change XP sources, point rules, prices, and caps.

pages.title: Sealed branches
pages.text: Some branches require a Skill Book. Consume its matching book once to learn its hidden branch. It grants no rank, XP, or points. Learned books survive death; duplicates are not consumed.$(br2)Learning removes the branch's book gate. Nodes appear as their other prerequisites are met within a discovered specialization.

pages.title: Recognize a Skill Book
pages.text: Skill Books use a flat book cover stamped with the matching node's icon. The token chooses the icon even before you discover or purchase that node.$(br2)A book with an unknown token or unavailable icon keeps its plain cover. Resource packs can replace the book texture and icon artwork.
